Account & privacy

Delete your account

Request permanent deletion of your Astro Pulse account and associated personal data. No app login is required on this page — verify with OTP. You can also delete from Profile in the mobile app.

Before you continue

  • Your wallet balance and consultation history will be permanently deleted once the request is approved.
  • Uploaded kundlis and birth details will be permanently deleted.
  • You cannot log in while a deletion request is pending (temporary deactivation is not the final step).
  • Active consultations must be ended before submitting a request.
  • Limited payment or tax records may be kept only where required by law or for fraud prevention — see our Privacy Policy.

Details are in our Data Deletion Policy and Privacy Policy · Need help? Contact support or email support@astropulse.in.

Verify your phone

Enter the mobile number linked to your Astro Pulse account. We'll send a one-time password to confirm it's you.
